changes.title: AWS CodeDeploy now supports suspending Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling processes
changes.detail: AWS CodeDeploy can now suspend Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling processes during EC2 in-place deployments to Auto Scaling groups. CodeDeploy is a fully managed service that automates application deployments to Amazon EC2 instances, on-premises servers, AWS Lambda functions, and Amazon ECS services. This launch helps prevent scaling activities from terminating or replacing instances while CodeDeploy is updating them, which can cause a deployment to fail. changes.title: Amazon EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML now supports search across multiple instance types and AWS Regions
changes.detail: Amazon EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML now lets customers search across multiple instance types and AWS Regions in a single search, making it easier to find and reserve the capacity their ML workloads need. With Capacity Blocks for ML, customers can reserve accelerated compute instances such as Amazon EC2 P6-B300, P6-B200, and Trn2 instances, for a future start date and for up to 6 months. Until now, customers looking to buy Capacity Blocks had to run a separate search for every instance type and Region combination.
